entries.title: Actual API and unchanged browser contract
entries.instructions: Keep the existing create_app(cfg, cors_origins=...) and launcher callable as facades. Preserve all 19 HTTP method/path contracts. Extract service seams from the 7,038-line module; do not replace its workflow behavior with the FORGE server.

entries.title: Pending actions, sessions and UI graph updates
entries.instructions: Keep session_id/client_turn_id/parent_turn_id, pending selection indexes, active-paper follow-ups, graph_update progress and response statuses. Preserve candidate/session graph visibility while separately gating publication. Never assume a LangGraph event is already an F2W UI event.

entries.title: Graph detail, editing and code-snippet contracts
entries.instructions: Translate existing UI graph detail/edit results over Tiled, including _action=upsert|unlink, relationship add/remove and publication provenance. Preserve external IDs and references; do not merely disable edits when retiring Splash. Unsupported mutation semantics block the release or require a separate owner-approved exception.

entries.title: Coordinator and CLI compatibility
entries.instructions: Keep configuration fields, workdir/artifact paths and supported command behavior. Preserve current Academy-facing integration until caller parity is demonstrated; the scoped LangGraph supervisor replaces orchestration gradually.

entries.title: Workflow intent routing
entries.instructions: Retain deterministic validation, pending-action handling, active-paper state and safe fallback while moving execution into LangGraph. No new default prompt or provider stack.

entries.title: Evidence ranking debate agent
entries.instructions: Retain candidate-ranking specialist behavior. It is not replaced by a generic retrieval tool without equivalent behavior and output tests.

entries.title: Active-paper bounded answers
entries.instructions: Preserve manifest-bounded pages and citation checking for the active extracted paper. New FORGE section/figure readers extend the evidence service, not permission to answer from unrelated corpus pages.

entries.title: Real retrieval, sufficiency and leeway
entries.instructions: Preserve lexical/semantic KG retrieval, separate graph identities, parallel paths, source_rag, existing contextual leeway and numeric-claim evidence rules. Ops/MP/live-Tiled branches already exist; retain them behind compatibility scope without adding FORGE experimental tools.

entries.title: KnowledgeGraph implementation and independent chat API
entries.instructions: Preserve both actual lexical and semantic implementations, BFS/context/evidence behaviors, knowledge-gap recording and six OpenAI/Ollama-compatible routes. Do not confuse this server with the 19-route UI agent server.

entries.title: Async F2W inference path
entries.instructions: Retain async messages-based contract and existing CBORG/Ollama configuration, timeout and tracing paths. Do not replace it with the different prompt-string synchronous client.

entries.title: Synchronous F2W inference path
entries.instructions: Keep chat(prompt, temperature, timeout, trace_label) and existing tracing/concurrency behavior. Adapt every FORGE paper inference site to a suitable existing F2W path; new multimodal/tool-call capabilities require a minimal additive reviewed extension.

entries.title: Existing LangGraph extraction loop
entries.instructions: LangGraph is already used: MessagesState, ToolNode, tool-call continuation and graph.compile. Adopt the shared registry/supervisor architecture, not a redundant first graph framework. Wrap current extraction before changing its behavior.

entries.title: Extractor orchestration and tool-capable model construction
entries.instructions: _build_llm already constructs ChatOpenAI for CBORG or Ollama /v1 and binds tools. Reuse that configuration seam without instantiating the full extractor to obtain a model. Preserve page fallback, concurrency, selected-page behavior, snippet extraction and provenance.

entries.title: Current extraction tools and full-list merge risk
entries.instructions: The inspected fuzzy_merge_term builds an LLM prompt from ALL store display names; do not claim ANN shortlisting is already implemented on this path. Preserve behavior at H2; add bounded candidate search/merge safety as a measured H3-approved improvement. Keep page/source context and evidence registration.

entries.title: Persistent extracted term records
entries.instructions: Preserve locking, merge semantics, progress fields, publications, code snippets and source metadata. Do not exchange TermStore for a FORGE record model by dropping unmapped fields.

entries.title: Extraction schema validation
entries.instructions: Retain actual category/slot correction and relation checks. The supplied RSoXS overlay still models RSoXSMeasurement as an ExperimentalTechnique subclass. Changing that is a scientific migration, not a packaging fix.

entries.title: Extraction record DTOs
entries.instructions: Map donor records to these actual fields, preserving publications, code/repository provenance and per-field uncertainty. Proposed WorkVersion/Mention models are separate H3 changes, not claimed current classes.

entries.title: Existing source RAG and document indexes
entries.proposed_destination: retain hybrid_rag/ first; later retrieval/ service facades
entries.instructions: Source-document RAG already exists and is toggled via source_rag/F2W_SOURCE_RAG. Preserve both literature and existing ops separation. New FORGE parsing must populate or adapt these indexes instead of building an unrelated parallel corpus.

entries.title: Actual BM25 index
entries.instructions: Do not describe independent lexical document retrieval as wholly future. Keep existing chunk IDs/index metadata and rebuild compatibility. Any new vector mode is additive and separately evaluated.

entries.title: Actual evidence-context builder
entries.instructions: This is a verified context builder, not retrieval/models.py. Keep source-kind partitions, budgets and literal citation grammar. New figure locators extend it without changing existing citation chip rendering.

entries.title: Hybrid evidence model and ranker
entries.instructions: Keep current provenance/source_kind/source_type/graph_id tags. Reconcile richer FORGE evidence objects without relabeling operational or Materials Project evidence as a paper statement.

entries.title: Download and acquisition behavior
entries.proposed_destination: app/modules/literature/ services under existing DownloadAgent facade
entries.instructions: Preserve OpenAlex/arXiv candidates, deduplication, ranking, PDF validation, preview and download manifest behavior. Port FORGE resolver/provider batching beneath that contract; do not bypass the separate candidate-choice/download/extraction UI flow.

entries.title: Harvest Work/version identity and operator paths
entries.instructions: The branch has implemented bibliographic near-duplicate/version workflows. Reuse these, with explicit H3 identity improvements; do not restart from only earlier design notes. Retain publication-list import and pending-PDF recovery.

entries.title: Graph construction and field retention
entries.proposed_destination: retain json2kg CLI facade + graph/snapshot services
entries.instructions: Freeze identifiers and field/edge retention. Preserve MatKG things/associations and snippet/license/source fields through Tiled projection. New revision/identity rules require explicit migration receipts; do not recreate IDs from new labels.

entries.title: Existing Tiled lookup path
entries.instructions: Tiled is present as lookup/enrichment, not yet a full replacement for every Splash edit/rebuild path. Preserve live_tiled/status/identity/neighborhood behavior and local-host policy while adding the required literature adapter. No new FORGE experimental functionality.

entries.title: Existing snapshot promotion and simulation fixtures
entries.proposed_destination: existing fixture/operator path + literature publication adapters
entries.instructions: Keep existing F2W fixture and snapshot-promotion behavior accounted for; do not move FORGE simulators into F2W or treat synthetic runs as paper gold data. Adapt approved publication code after ownership/recovery review.

entries.title: Scoped multi-graph identities
entries.instructions: Keep (graph_id,node id) identity, selected graph lists, primary viewer path, available_graphs/selected_graph_ids and same-label collision behavior. Do not union literature, ops or Tiled into one anonymous graph.

entries.title: Session persistence and compression
entries.instructions: Retain current on-disk session state, topic/history rewriting and compression boundaries. Reuse source paths or migrate with receipts. Checkpoints do not replace browser localStorage or workflow_state.json automatically.

entries.title: Persistent approval workflow
entries.instructions: Preserve current pending downloads/extractions across restarts and named-session isolation. Add explicit mapping from old workflow phases to LangGraph state. Do not replay approved effects when resuming an interrupt.

entries.title: Existing execution trace and annotations
entries.instructions: F2W already has detailed traces and user annotations. Combine with GraphRecorder event sinks; preserve turn IDs, redaction, unclipped detail and UI feedback endpoints. Do not replace annotations with a donor-only tracing system.

entries.title: Scientific provenance helpers
entries.instructions: Preserve existing PROV vocabulary and structured extraction/snapshot links, distinct from FORGE operational execution provenance.

entries.title: Configuration precedence
entries.proposed_destination: existing project_config + application instance config adapter
entries.instructions: Preserve environment/config.yml precedence and secret sourcing. Library import must not load arbitrary host .env or change globals; CLI remains the explicit config-loading boundary.

entries.title: Existing Materials Project evidence
entries.instructions: Already participates in F2W QA. Do not remove it merely because donor migration is literature-only. Keep [MP:] source labeling; do not broaden it into experimental analysis.

entries.title: Current corpus repair
entries.instructions: Preserve current repair utilities as read/propose adapters; characterize them before substituting FORGE campaigns. No bulk apply without source/scope/semantic review.

entries.title: Current corpus quality checks
entries.proposed_destination: evals/ corpus QA + retained operator CLI
entries.instructions: Retain quality checks and exact failure categories. These checks do not establish the intended Work/measurement schema is already active.

entries.title: Existing operator invocation
entries.proposed_destination: scripts/run.py facade -> retained extractor/new job service
entries.instructions: Preserve command options and path resolution. New library packaging cannot require all operators to switch imports simultaneously.
